summary: FiEE, Inc., a Delaware-incorporated, Osaka-based prepackaged software issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026, reporting entry into a form of Indemnification Agreement under Item 1.01, with the form filed as Exhibit 10.1. New director Angel Colon signed on October 12, 2026, and on October 15, 2026 the remaining directors and executive officers—Cao Yu, Chan Oi Fat, Hu Bin, Hongya Wen and CEO Li Wai Chung—executed identical agreements superseding prior ones. The agreements provide indemnification and expense advancement; no transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine governance filing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
